line: Crowley numbers Chokmah 2 and calls it the first manifestation; Jung names it in a passage reporting Franck's trinity, and gives it no number.

sections.title: Crowley's number 2
sections.line: Crowley gives Chokmah the Two, then reads the number back to the first manifestation.

quotes.quote: Chokmah is really No. I and not No.2, because he is the first manifestation;
Magical manifestation of Chokmah, Wisdom, the Logos.

sections.title: Wisdom, the Father and Mercury
sections.line: Crowley's Hermit and Magus chapters name Chokmah as Wisdom, the Father, and Mercury, the way to Kether.

quotes.quote: Father, who is Wisdom; he is the highest form of Mercury
Mercury as Chokmah “through whom alone we can approach Kether.”

sections.title: The path to Binah
sections.line: The Daleth path joins Chokmah to Binah, uniting Father and Mother in Crowley's Empress chapter.

quotes.quote: On the Tree of Life, Daleth is the path leading from Chokmah to Binah, uniting the Father with the Mother.

sections.title: Neptune in the Universe list
sections.line: Item 2 of Crowley's ten-item list is the sphere of the fixed stars, under Neptune. The list does not name Chokmah, so the number is the only link to it there.

quotes.quote: The sphere of the Zodiac or fixed stars, represented by Neptune.

sections.title: Jung's trinity
sections.line: Jung names Hokhmah with Kether and Binah in Franck's trinity. He gives it no number and no planet.

quotes.quote: Franck establishes a connection between 32 and the cabalistic trinity, Kether, Binah, and Hokhmah
